description: We are AstroVive , a team passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Space Exploration. We are developing an AI-powered health monitoring solution for astronauts during space missions. Our interests include software development, data analysis, and building innovative solutions to real-world challenges. We are excited to learn, collaborate, and turn ideas into practical solutions.
summary:
Overview:
AstroVive is a comprehensive health and wellbeing web application designed for diagnostics, continuous health tracking, and risk monitoring. The platform integrates an interactive dashboard and specialized diagnostic views to help users monitor critical health vitals and detect potential medical risks in real time.  
Key Features:
Interactive Dashboard: Provides a centralized, real-time overview of key health indicators and user vitals.
Diagnostic Engine: Analyzes vital signs (such as Heart Rate, Blood Oxygen Levels, Body Temperature, and Respiration Rate) to detect critical health conditions like hypoxia or cardiorespiratory strain.  
Risk & Hazard Monitoring: Flags abnormal patterns and triggers emergency alerts with structured action plans.  
Wellbeing & Reports: Tracks general wellbeing metrics and maintains a detailed history of health reports for review.  
Voice Interaction: Supports modern browser-based speech APIs for hands-free interaction and accessibility
details:
Backend: Python (Flask framework) & Streamlit for diagnostic interfaces.
Database: SQLite (astra.db) paired with JSON data management.
Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript for a responsive, interactive user experience.
